system.text:
If the Lord Protector’s player uses one of his Beliefs to describe his vow to defend the citadel/wilderlands/royalty, and such a vow is relevant to the current game, the Lord Protector receives a 2D reputation (he’s the boss) and a 2D major affiliation within the Protectors. These may be further improved upon with resource points.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Elven lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 349
